messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: canary p95 latency breach detected: 520ms (threshold 350ms). Error rate +2.3% vs baseline. Suggested action: pause rollout, reduce canary to 1% or rollback to stable v2.8.4. Policy: change-window requires manual approval for full rollback during business hours.

zoe-eng: noticed a surge right after the quantization kernel bump landed. Was that gated?

mike-oncall: canary slice is 8% right now. I can drop to 1% to preserve health while we debug. Do we want a full cut to 0%?

tara-prod: change-window ops note: full rollback during the current window needs +1 from PM and Ops lead. Reduced traffic to 1% OK without extra approvals.

jay-pm: agree reduce to 1% first. Also need to prepare a pinned-version notice for Dedicated customers in case we need to force a rollback that affects pinned releases. Lucy, can you draft an FYI?

mike-oncall: running command: 
```
# deployctl traffic adjust --env prod --release v3.2.0 --slice canary --percent 1
deployctl: adjusting slice... OK (8% -> 1%)
```

mike-oncall: metrics started to settle, p95 down to ~370ms but still above baseline. Error rate dropping slowly.

zoe-eng: we rolled in a small quantization micro-optim in this train; will trigger a canary build with quant off and run a quick compare.

sre-bot: NOTICE: autoscaler paused scaleup; auto-rollback disabled for this release (manual-only during change window).

jay-pm: authorize manual rollback if 30m aggregate doesn't return to baseline. If rollback is needed, prefer rolling rollback to v2.8.4 to avoid impacting dedicated customers who may be pinned — include pinned version override steps.

lucy-csm: drafting customer note: "We're monitoring a limited performance regression during a staged rollout. We've reduced exposure and are investigating; no action required by customers. We'll notify pinned/dedicated customers directly if we schedule any rollback that affects their pinned version." Thoughts?

mike-oncall: quick status: A/B test with quant off shows p95 ~ 320ms (close to baseline). Looks like quant micro-optim caused regressions at this perf profile.

zoe-eng: plan: keep canary at 1%, revert the quant micro-optim in the canary image, run 2x 10m windows. If stable, promote fix and resume rollout. If not stable, escalate to rollback to v2.8.4 per PM approval.

jay-pm: approving that plan. No full rollback yet. Lucy, send the internal CSM note now; set a follow-up for external comms only if we trigger rollback.

lucy-csm: sent internal note to CSMs + queued a template for external release notes if rollback required.

mike-oncall: executing canary image patch (quant disabled) and redeploying canary pod group. Logs: 
```
# kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deploy/canary-v3-2
deployment.apps/canary-v3-2 restarted
```

mike-oncall: after patch, p95=340ms -> trending toward baseline. Monitoring for 20 more minutes.

deploy-bot: UPDATE: telemetry window 10m: latency trending down, error rate back to +0.2%. Auto-rollback remains off.

zoe-eng: we'll prepare a changelog blurb referencing the quant opt and the rollback plan, and include notes for release notes about the fix.

jay-pm: final decision: keep canary at 1% while we validate patched image. If 30m from now metrics are within SLO, resume rollout and close incident. If not, mike to initiate manual rollback using the authorized rollback command below and tag me + tara-prod.

mike-oncall: acknowledged. Rollback command (if needed):
```
# manual rollback to stable
deployctl rollback --env prod --to v2.8.4 --strategy rolling --reason "canary perf regression"
```

lucy-csm: preparing customer message templates for both outcomes (resume vs rollback). Will include note for Dedicated customers about pin handling and timeline.

jay-pm: thanks team. Keeping this thread pinned until resolved. Will post final summary once we either resume or rollback.

mike-oncall: monitoring continues. No customer-facing comm yet.

sre-bot: CLOSED: follow-up: file an RCA doc if we end up rolling back. Otherwise file a small postmortem and add quant flag to the canary checklist.
